5 · Bird From a Name (Pañcha Pakshi)
Identify someone else's Pañcha Pakshi bird from the first vowel sound of their name, for when their birth star is unknown (Table No.4) — a separate method from the reference person's own birth-star bird above, and independent of everything else on this page.
On precision. Sun & Moon use truncated Meeus-type series (≈1–5′ accuracy). Mercury–Saturn use two-body Keplerian elements (perturbations ignored, ≈0.2–1° drift possible). Rāhu is the mean node. Good enough to teach the method; not a substitute for a certified ephemeris at a house-cusp boundary or eclipse-grade work.
Set your reference star and the moment to judge, then press Cast & Judge Muhūrta.

Pañcha-Tarot WESTERN × JYOTISH · SHADOW READ

A 78-card deck mapped onto the jyotish lattice — graha→Major Arcana (trump), rashi→numbered card (decan), bhāva→court. The cards are read as a shadow complement to this chart: they add colour and association, they never override a jyotish hard rule. Card schema after Kenner, Tarot & Astrology (2012).
"Though my soul may set in darkness, it will rise in perfect light;
I have loved the stars too truly to be fearful of the night."

Wishing you every happiness, healing from sorrow, guidance by inner light,
and continuing success in your study of the samayavidya.
The information in this application is provided for educational study of the Jyotishavidya tradition only — it is not fortune-telling, and the tradition offers no moral judgments. Without awareness, there is no free will.
